resources.string: Android engineer, eight years across consumer apps, financial flows, connected-home platforms, and embedded diagnostic tools. Most of my work today is in Kotlin Multiplatform — sharing logic between iOS and Android without the seams showing. The products have ranged from sensors that report once a day to apps with millions of daily sessions; what stays constant is the discipline, not the stack.\n\nThe parts I care about most are the boring ones: clear code, tests that earn their place, dependency graphs simple enough to navigate without a map, and design choices that still make sense a year later. Working with global teams from Brazil taught me to over-explain in writing — a good PR description saves someone a 2 a.m. ping, and I\'ve been on both sides of that.
Built a strong foundation in programming, databases, project management, systems analysis, and software architecture.
Currently open to selective consulting projects and speaking engagements. Let's talk.
